subject.title: All .large bubbles should have scrollable body regardless of truncation

question: Should native chat adopt always-on bounded inner body scrolling for large/tall bubbles, or use a separate full-message reader affordance?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the permanent UX choice affects nested gestures, selection, accessibility, and streaming layout across iOS and Android.

options.title: Adopt Bounded Inner Body Scroll
options.body: Define the current tall-bubble rule and implement bounded body scrolling consistently in iOS and Android native chat with live nested-scroll proof.

options.title: Use A Reader Affordance
options.body: Avoid nested scrolling and provide a separate full-message reader or expansion surface for tall native content.

options.title: Defer Native Body Reader
options.body: Keep transcript-level scrolling only until maintainers decide the nested-scroll complexity is worth the UX change.

recommendation.title: Adopt Bounded Inner Body Scroll
recommendation.body: Define the current tall-bubble rule and implement bounded body scrolling consistently in iOS and Android native chat with live nested-scroll proof.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already reviewed this issue and merged the adjacent native reader-managed scrolling PR, making him the strongest routing owner for the product choice.
